title: Monthly Digest

brand_lift.note: These are Google Search numbers, not social engagement — how often our brand and channels surface when people search. Branded search covers branded queries on inquired.com; YouTube and Instagram were verified as GSC Social Signals properties on Jul 30, 2026 (no backfill — August 2026 is the baseline month, so the first clean MoM comparison lands in the early-October digest). LinkedIn has no GSC connector: it's owned by Microsoft and isn't integrated with Google. Updates with the monthly digest run once the GSC API is wired.

seasonality.note: Close/fiscal year Oct 1–Sep 30. District purchasing peaks spring–summer (Apr–Aug) for the next school year.
